20.example: Other stories are about a wise fool named Goha.

20.example: The desert wilderness has many names in the Bedu language, my native tongue, because the desert has many faces.
20.exampleZh: 沙漠的荒野在贝都语中有许多名字,我的母语,因为沙漠有许多相貌.

20.example: She takes care of our tent, which is made of goat hair and easily portable.

20.example: My people are always on the move through the deserts of Arabia, tending our camels and goats.
20.exampleZh: 我国人民总是在穿越阿拉伯沙漠,照顾我们的骆驼和山羊。

20.example: We never stay in one place very long, but we enjoy the region around the oasis at Al-Hasa the most.
20.exampleZh: 我们从来没有在一个地方呆过很长一段时间,但我们最享受在Al-Hasa绿洲周围的地区。

20.example: When my family travels from water hole to water hole, all our animals travel with us.
20.exampleZh: 当我的家人从水洞到水洞旅行时,我们所有的动物都和我们一起旅行.

20.example: One day Goha borrowed a large pot from a neighbor.
20.exampleZh: 一日果哈从邻人借取一大锅.
